I purchased a Gripp Clear MagSafe Case for my Apple iPhone 17 Pro from Imagine Store. However, after using the cover, I noticed that the clear cover has developed a yellowish shade, which affects the appearance and quality of the product. Since the cover was purchased as a premium accessory, I request you to kindly inspect the issue and provide a suitable replacement or solution at the earliest. Overall, the service was excellent, and it made me feel confident in my purchase. I would definitely recommend this store for anyone looking to buy an iPhone.
